title: The Molecular Mechanisms of Bergapten Against Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm: Evidence From Network Pharmacology, Molecular Docking/Dynamics, and Experimental Validation.
authors: Xu, Fujia; Luo, Sihan; Huang, Zhenhua; Wang, Junfen; Li, Tian; Zhong, Lintao; Si, Xiaoyun
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用网络药理学、分子对接/动力学和实验验证探讨补骨脂素对腹主动脉瘤的保护作用，核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: This study endeavors to assess the potential protective role of bergapten (BP) in mitigating abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) and to decipher the underlying mechanisms and molecular targets. Network pharmacology was utilized to search for potential targets of BP against AAA. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were utilized to validate the interaction of BP with core targets, and then the therapeutic effect and mechanism of BP on AAA were verified by using an elastase-induced AAA model. Network pharmacology analysis identified five pharmacological targets for BP, including EGFR, SRC, PIK3CA, PIK3CB, and JAK2. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations further prioritized JAK2 as the most promising candidate for the potential treatment of AAA. The results of animal experiments demonstrated that BP significantly reduced the expression of inflammatory cytokines IL-6, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta in the aortic tissue of AAA mouse model, and inhibited the phosphorylation of JAK2 and STAT3. BP plays an important role in the treatment of AAA, and it may become a promising drug to combat AAA progression. The inhibitory effect of BP on AAA vascular progression and the attenuation of inflammatory cell infiltration may be related to the regulation of JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在评估佛手柑内酯（bergapten, BP）在缓解腹主动脉瘤（abdominal aortic aneurysm, AAA）中的潜在保护作用，并阐明其潜在机制和分子靶点。采用网络药理学方法寻找BP对抗AAA的潜在靶点。利用分子对接和分子动力学模拟验证BP与核心靶点的相互作用，随后通过弹性蛋白酶诱导的AAA模型验证BP对AAA的治疗效果及机制。网络药理学分析确定了BP的五个药理学靶点，包括EGFR、SRC、PIK3CA、PIK3CB和JAK2。分子对接和分子动力学模拟进一步将JAK2列为潜在治疗AAA的最有前景候选靶点。动物实验结果表明，BP显著降低了AAA小鼠模型主动脉组织中炎症细胞因子IL-6、TNF-α和IL-1β的表达，并抑制了JAK2和STAT3的磷酸化。BP在AAA治疗中发挥重要作用，可能成为对抗AAA进展的有前景药物。BP对AAA血管进展的抑制作用及对炎症细胞浸润的减弱可能与JAK2/STAT3信号通路的调控有关。
